## Monthly Teaching Repo Audit — [Month Year]

@github-copilot Please audit this repository for completeness, accuracy, and new lesson opportunities.

### Completeness Audit
- Review lesson markdown files for placeholders or thin sections
- Check `examples/`, `exercises/`, and `solutions/` for scaffolds that still need real content
- Fill any placeholder files you find

### Accuracy Review
- Check Python content for deprecated patterns or outdated APIs
- Verify AWS RDS and ECS content against current AWS guidance
- Review DevOps and API lessons for outdated best practices

### New Content Research
- Research new Python, DevOps, AWS, and AI agent trends relevant to this repository
- Identify missing lessons or updates worth adding

### Deliverables
- Summarize findings in a structured comment
- Open a PR if substantial improvements are warranted
- Update README indexes when new lessons are added
